# AuditAI Documentation Index

> Smart Contract Security Audit Agent — 5-layer AI pipeline with on-chain attestation.

## Documentation

- [index.md](index.md) — Project overview, features, quick start
- [getting-started/installation.md](getting-started/installation.md) — Installation guide, prerequisites, environment setup

- [user-guide/mcp.md](user-guide/mcp.md) — MCP server integration for IDEs and agents

## Key Concepts

- **Dual-engine detection** — Slither + Aderyn static analysis with LLM consensus scoring
- **RAG knowledge base** — 2,450 chunks (477 Solodit reports + 303 reference docs) via ChromaDB
- **5-agent pipeline** — Auditor → Architect → Code Generator → Refiner → Validator
- **EAS attestation** — Verifiable audit credentials on Sepolia testnet
- **MCP server** — Expose audit tools to Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients
